saw_lines: Hair buyers try one product, reorder it for months, and stay only if the first bottle works.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the scroll stops and before any proof appears.
Your site cites over 400,000 customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Put 400,000 on every creative and in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your site cites over 400,000 customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so cold buyers have no trust signal. Put 400,000 on every creative and in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 10% off a first order, yet 0 of 14 ads mention it. A new buyer has no price reason to act, so they scroll past. Put the 10% offer in the first line of three new ads.

Your site has a delivery page, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A new buyer who wonders how it arrives must leave the ad to check, and many won’t. Answer it in the first line of your ads.

8 of 14 ads use claim words like clinically or guaranteed results. Those words invite review scrutiny and make a cold buyer doubt the product. Swap them for what customers noticed, like thicker hair after a few weeks.
